note: Pre-existing modules over the family's 800-line hard cap (AGENTS.md: target ~500, split past ~800). Each entry is recorded technical debt, not an endorsement: the exemption exists only so the gate could land without a retroactive refactor, and **splitting each of these is outstanding work**. This file is consumed by scripts/check-module-size.mjs, which converts `path` (EnvoyDev-relative) into the EnvoyMesh-relative key the family checker expects. Paths are keyed the same way on purpose: a dead entry (a path that no longer exists) is an ERROR, because a rename would otherwise leave the real file unprotected. An entry whose file falls back under the cap is a WARNING telling you to delete it. `lines` is the baseline the entry was granted at, and scripts/check-module-size.mjs compares it: an exempt file that grows past its recorded number prints a WARNING, so the debt cannot grow while the number stays at whatever it was when the gate landed. Removing entries is the goal; adding one to silence NEW growth is not.
